headline: R-TYPE S3: four green bits and a twin-hearted dread
lede: The convoy just got deeper. Chain four green capsules and the R-7C rides inside a rotating shield of bits that eats rounds, hunters and larvae alike — and every bit aboard adds its own stream of fire. Break the Phase-1 bio-ship and the stage no longer ends: the wreck hands you to a second leg that locks onto the PHASE-2 fortress, two cores venting on staggered clocks, the survivor speeding up when its twin falls. Clear only when both hearts stop.

notes.text: R-TYPE S3 shipped via PR #2828: bit chain + orbit shield, LEG 2 handoff after Phase-1's wreck, Phase-2 twin-core fortress with staggered vents and an enraging survivor. Double Dragon's hideout (S3, #2822) went live earlier on the same busy evening.

The QA lane polished R-TYPE S2 in the same files while this stage was being built — the two lanes' work rebased together and both rule sets went green at once: rtypecheck 84/84 with three named mutants (armour-blind, pod-blind, new shield-blind) and contractcheck 769/769. The autopilot clears 5 of 12 seeds through BOTH bosses without ever touching a bit.

Honest rule evolution: S2's spare-S.E.E.D. law ('pays points, not a second shell') became the original's deeper law — a spare capsule chains a BIT. The stage stays open for S4 co-op; the S3 polish pass is already filed for the QA lane (#2831).
